vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
manual_feedback: Physical corrections keep existing RL path. New button corrections are retractable contextual labels with explicit Control provenance.
manual_feedback_ui: Four actions: Shadow/Control, Wrong decision, Settings, Teach; undo in Teach and Settings
manual_feedback_context: bounded full eligible HA context snapshot on every manual correction; supervised relevance can promote previously unselected entities
manual_feedback_schema: online schema rotation preserves matching feature weights and fixed home-intelligence slots
manual_feedback_safety: Physical corrections cannot mutate policy during historical training. Button labels remain independent; Control requires qualification, review, freshness and device guards; matched user labels bypass statistical confidence gates.
desired_teaching: New buttons store retractable contextual Desired labels; no direct HA call, manual hold, or pending-action reward
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID
button_teaching: Retractable contextual user labels, independent of base RL matrices; historical as-of snapshots; bounded local matching
teaching_history: Bounded replay plus indexed as-of sampling for dense radar streams; 31 day windows; <=1000 chart points; exact point inspection
